title: ModelLink Public Data Schema
description: Public JSON contract for ModelLink catalog, provider, model and package manifest data.

attachment.description: Whether attachments are supported. Missing on optional metadata means unknown.

reasoning.description: Whether reasoning is supported. Missing means unknown; false means explicitly unsupported.

tool_call.description: Whether tool calling is supported. Missing means unknown; false means explicitly unsupported.

structured_output.description: Whether structured output is supported. Missing means unknown; false means explicitly unsupported.

temperature.description: Whether temperature is explicitly adjustable. Missing means unknown; false means fixed or unsupported.

input.description: Input modalities accepted by the model.

output.description: Output modalities produced by the model.

modalities.description: Input and output modalities exposed by this model endpoint.

input.description: Maximum input length in tokens when separately documented.

output.description: Maximum output length in tokens when documented.

limit.description: Token limits published for the base model.

Protocol.description: Protocol used to call a provider endpoint.

id.description: Stable endpoint ID referenced by provider models.

api.description: Base API URL for this endpoint.

default.description: Marks the endpoint represented by the provider-level protocol and API fields.

ProviderEndpoint.description: A protocol-specific API endpoint exposed by a provider.

models.description: Official catalog of models available from this provider.

pricing.description: Official pricing, subscription plan, or purchase page.

api_key.description: Official instructions for applying for and configuring an API key.

console.description: Official console used to manage API keys and the provider account.

ProviderLinks.description: Purpose-specific official links for integrating with this provider.

field.description: Request body field used by this reasoning control.

endpoints.description: Provider endpoint IDs where this reasoning control applies.

values.description: Supported reasoning effort values; JSON null disables reasoning when supported.

default.description: Default reasoning effort when the provider documents one.

field.description: Request body field used by this reasoning control.

endpoints.description: Provider endpoint IDs where this reasoning control applies.

min.description: Minimum reasoning token budget; -1 may represent automatic allocation.

field.description: Request body field used by this reasoning control.

endpoints.description: Provider endpoint IDs where this reasoning control applies.

ReasoningOption.description: Provider-specific reasoning control; type discriminates toggle, effort and token-budget forms.

attachment.description: Whether attachments are supported. Missing on optional metadata means unknown.

reasoning.description: Whether reasoning is supported. Missing means unknown; false means explicitly unsupported.

reasoning_options.description: Provider-specific controls for enabling or configuring reasoning.

tool_call.description: Whether tool calling is supported. Missing means unknown; false means explicitly unsupported.

interleaved.description: Whether reasoning content is returned alongside output, optionally naming its response field.

structured_output.description: Whether structured output is supported. Missing means unknown; false means explicitly unsupported.

temperature.description: Whether temperature is explicitly adjustable. Missing means unknown; false means fixed or unsupported.

input.description: Input modalities accepted by the model.

output.description: Output modalities produced by the model.

modalities.description: Input and output modalities exposed by this model endpoint.

input.description: Maximum input length in tokens when separately documented.

output.description: Maximum output length in tokens when documented.

limit.description: Token limits exposed by this provider model endpoint.

endpoints.description: Provider endpoint IDs enabled for this model; missing means the provider default endpoint.

cost_points.description: Plan point consumption per the number of tokens declared by per_tokens.

cost.description: Prices in USD per million tokens.

cost_cn.description: Prices in CNY per million tokens.

protocol.description: Default protocol used by this provider.

api.description: Base API URL for the default endpoint.

endpoints.description: All protocol-specific endpoints exposed by this provider.

plans_cn.description: Subscription plans published for users in China.

links.description: Purpose-specific official links for integrating with this provider.
